verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
ONNUMIRIZE olw'ebibi
Mwoyo Mutukuvu;
Eby'omu bulamu bwange
Byerulibwe mangu.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Yesu amaanyi ebyama,
N'esulo-ez'omu nda
Ez'ebirowoozo bynge,
Ozimbikkulire.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Onjakize-omusana gwo,
Ommulise mu nda,
Ommanyise-ebibi byange
Byonna-ebikisibwa.

verse.name: v4
v5
verse.lines:
Bwe ntyo bwe ndifukamira
Mu maaso ga Yesu,
Naakwebalizanga ddala,
Nga neewombeese nnyo
